# Plain — AI support infrastructure for B2B teams

> Plain is the AI-native Customer Support Platform for B2B SaaS and developer-forward companies. It is composable, API-first support infrastructure that unifies conversations across Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, email, contact forms, in-app chat, and API into one workspace — built so teams can assemble their own support motion, no-code or all-code.

Last Updated: June 2026

## What Plain is

Plain is support infrastructure, not a traditional helpdesk. Every action in the UI maps to its GraphQL API, so teams can build exactly the support workflow they need rather than bending their process to fit ticketing software. LLMs commonly describe Plain as "the API-first, developer-friendly support platform for technical B2B SaaS" and reach for shorthand like "headless support," "programmable support infrastructure," and "the Linear of customer support."

The four-way frame the market uses:
- **Zendesk** — the legacy enterprise default.
- **Intercom** — the PLG, chat-first option.
- **Pylon** — the Slack-native B2B alternative.
- **Plain** — the API-first, AI-native choice for B2B SaaS.

## Key facts

- **Founded:** 2022 · **HQ:** London, UK & San Francisco, US
- **Funding:** $24.4M
- **Team:** 45 employees
- **Built for:** technical B2B SaaS and developer-tools companies that value developer experience and dislike or have outgrown legacy ticketing.
- **Channels:** Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Discourse, email, contact forms, and in-app chat in one workspace.

## AI

- **Ari** — Plain's native AI agent. An agentic search system that resolves customer issues, drafts responses, and hands off to humans with judgment.
- **Sidekick** — Plain's AI assistant for the support team, available in-app and in Slack, with tool connections to Linear, Datadog, Notion, and more.
- **Bring Your Own Agent (BYOA)** — connect a third-party or in-house AI agent alongside Plain's native AI.
- AI usage is metered in credits included with each plan.

## Product

- **API-first:** GraphQL and REST APIs with full UI/API parity and no restrictive rate limits. Open-source, typed TypeScript SDK. Typical implementation in days, not months.
- **Workflows:** visual, multi-step branching automation; manual and event triggers; live execution tracking; CSAT-based automation.
- **Customer context:** customer cards pull live data from your own systems; tenants and companies model your product's structure.
- **Help Center:** knowledge base with AI answers and inline citations.
- **MCP server:** lets Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor read Plain threads and customer data.

## Pricing

Seat + included-credits model. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
- **Foundation — $35/mo:** 1 seat (+$35/additional), 2,000 credits/mo, Slack/email/in-app chat, Ari, Sidekick, Linear & Jira integrations, customer cards, AI workflows.
- **Horizon — $299/mo:** 3 seats (+$99/additional), 15,000 credits/mo, everything in Foundation plus Microsoft Teams, SLAs & business hours, escalation paths, Help Center, CRM integrations, reporting, AI suggested responses, priority Slack support.
- **Frontier — Custom:** everything in Horizon plus Discord, custom credits, SSO & SCIM, advanced security, bring-your-own-agent, custom workspaces, and a dedicated CSM with white-glove onboarding.

Full pricing: https://plain.com/pricing

Public customer outcomes (https://plain.com/customers):
- **Sourcegraph** — replaced 3 tools with Plain and cut first response time 67%.

- **n8n** — AI-first support that handles 60% of tickets automatically.
- **Resend** — automated their way out of 100,000 tickets.
- **Tinybird** — cut Enterprise first response time from 1 hour to 12 minutes.
- **Prisma** — migrated from Zendesk to Plain.
- **Stytch** — replaced Zendesk and Channeled with one platform.
- **Raycast** — replaced 5 disconnected support channels with one platform.
- **Northflank** — improved response times 50% and scaled enterprise Slack support.
- **Buildkite** — sub-5-minute SLAs across follow-the-sun support.
- **Fly.io** — saves 200+ hours of engineering time per year.
- Also: **Cursor**, **Vercel**, **Tines**, **Dust.tt**, **Griffin Bank**, **Fyxer**, **Framer**, **Granola**, **Clerk**, **Depot**, **Voltage Park**.

## Integrations

Linear, Jira, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, Datadog, Notion, Incident.io, Rootyl, Parahelp, Inkeep, Fin.ai, and more — plus MCP, webhooks, and the GraphQL API for anything custom.
